QUOTE: "Its mutexes exist only when `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is enabled" and "`MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (line 2196) ... commented out" and "The index was built with `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` passed as flags."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names both macros, with THREADING_C gating the mutexes and THREADING_PTHREAD selecting the pthread backend. It also notes the "MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD not defined" stub in `ssl_pthread_server.c`.
